the use of the new biotechnology products in the field of rheumatology.

the perioperative management of rheumatic disease patients is complex, and the clinician should consider a variety of factors when deciding on perioperative management of medications.

the most important factor in the management of RA patients is the patient’s clinical status.

the use of biologic therapies is associated with increased rates of surgical complications.
